name: Emarsys
description: SAP Emarsys Customer Engagement provides contact, campaign, automation, email, SMS, loyalty, voucher, and behavioral-data APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect dedicated customer-owned OAuth client credentials. Relay pins six v3 routes: two account-configuration reads run directly, two exact campaign/contact reads and two one-contact writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and opt-in=true additionally requires recorded double-opt-in evidence.

credentialRequirements.name: EMARSYS_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Emarsys OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned least-privilege API user client ID.

credentialRequirements.name: EMARSYS_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Emarsys OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay exchanges this customer-owned secret at the fixed Emarsys token endpoint and never exposes it to agents.

capabilities.label: Read campaign or contact
capabilities.description: Use one exact non-raw campaign read and one exact email contact lookup with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one contact
capabilities.description: Use two one-contact writes with approval, authorization, and double-opt-in enforcement.

allowed.label: Read Emarsys fields and categories
allowed.description: Read bounded account field definitions or email campaign categories from fixed v3 routes.

approvalRequired.label: Read Emarsys campaign or contact
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact email campaign without raw content or look up one contact by email.

approvalRequired.label: Create or update one Emarsys contact
approvalRequired.description: Create or update one authorized email contact with explicit opt-in state.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Client credentials, access tokens, authorization headers, and credential-bearing response fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk or export APIs
blocked.description: Batch contact operations, exports, imports, response streams, relational data, Open Data, and unbounded reads are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Campaign launch, transactional/event triggers, content/templates, lists/segments, automations, SMS, loyalty, vouchers, keys/users, and destructive operations remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only six pinned v3 routes run on fixed API/token origins; arbitrary paths, URLs, methods, headers, dynamic fields, raw campaign content, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Field/category reads run directly; exact campaign/contact reads and both one-contact writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and opt-in=true additionally requires recorded double-opt-in evidence.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All six selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; contact/double-opt-in attestations, fixed routing, allowlists, bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six pinned Emarsys routes and performs a fixed client-credentials exchange without exposing secrets or access tokens to agents.
Railway mounts six pinned Emarsys routes and performs a fixed client-credentials exchange without exposing secrets or access tokens to agents.

providerSetup.blocker: Emarsys requires a customer-owned least-privilege OAuth API user, client credentials, contact field configuration, and permission-based double-opt-in process. No console, API user/app, credentials, contact, consent, campaign, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create and privilege a dedicated staging API user outside this worker, configure its client credentials in Railway staging, and verify token exchange, fields/categories, exact campaign/contact reads, approval and contact/double-opt-in denial/allow, one-contact create/update and opt-out, response bounds, rate behavior, secret rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: The SAP Emarsys developer portal documents the fixed Core API origin, REST style, OAuth 2.0 authentication, v3 contact/campaign/field endpoints, and separate Loyalty, Voucher, SMS, and Web Extend surfaces.

The official current collection documents client-credentials authentication at auth.emarsys.net, bearer use, fixed api.emarsys.net v3 routes, contact batch ceilings, and the selected field/category/campaign/contact operations.
Emarsys documents system field IDs 1/2/3 and opt-in field 31, API values 1/2, empty-value risks, and the requirement that opt-in true follow a double-opt-in process.
Emarsys documents confirmed opt-in as a baseline and double opt-in as the recommended standard for permission-based messaging.
